verdict.rationale: Mailgun docs explicitly cover open/click tracking (mailgun-docs-7/27) and real-time event webhooks (mailgun-docs-8), and community feedback corroborates strong logging with full message detail (mailgun-comm-15). However, the pack lacks explicit documentation of a dedicated Events API endpoint for querying per-message event history (e.g., filtering by message-id) — missing for 10: explicit Events API reference/examples, per-message event query documentation, and independent confirmation of API-based (non-webhook) history retrieval.
